name: sprot-ant
description: 智慧体育：根目录聚合启动/构建脚本（backend · uni-vue3-app · pc-web）

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix uni-vue3-app && npm install --prefix pc-web
scripts.dev:stack: concurrently -n api,h5 -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:h5"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,h5,pc -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:h5" "npm run dev:pc"
